race.title: Pennine Flooring On The Radio Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: GASMANI shaped promisingly on his chasing debut when runner-up over this C&D a month ago, form which has been working out well, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Big Cadillac isn't taken lightly, though, having made a successful start to his chasing career, with The Price of Peace one to note for last year's winning yard. GASMANI (IRE) BIG CADILLAC (IRE) THE PRICE OF PEACE (IRE)
